FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Animal Filtering Update
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Some changes to how animals are filtered.

patchNoteLines.li: Remove the "AnimalAlpha" trade tag from the blacklist
Expose the list of blacklisted trade tags and animal defs in XML, specifically on the ResourceFilterExtension_Animals (found on RTD_Animals)

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Event UI Minor Update
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Some small fixes to the event UI.

patchNoteLines.li: The list of required policies would wrap if it got too long. Now, it's truncated with elipsis, with a tooltip that shows all policies.
Permanent stat modifiers are more clearly separated from temporary modifiers

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Extensibility update
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Adds an interface to let submods contribute to a settlement's income or upkeep directly.

patchNoteLines.li: Adds IProfitContributor interface. Can be implemented on a WorldObjectComp to affect the income and upkeep of the associated WorldSettlementFC

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Settlement Founding Change
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Adds a "Confirm" dialog when founding a new settlement.

patchNoteLines.li: Adds a "confirm" dialog when founding a settlement, with a setting to disable the dialog
